# ghost/shopping-list

Shopping List app (F-Droid): add items with a quantity, add several at once, read the whole list back. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/shopping-list
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/shopping-list add_item --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/shopping-list add_items --device <serial> --param items=<items>
ghost skill run ghost/shopping-list get_items --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/shopping-list check_item --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/shopping-list remove_checked --device <serial> --param confirm=<confirm>
```

## Actions

- `add_item`: Add milk to my shopping list
- `add_items`: Add milk, eggs and bread to my shopping list
- `get_items`: What is on my shopping list?
- `check_item`: Tick off milk on my shopping list
- `remove_checked`: Remove the items I already bought from my shopping list
